transcript.content: Hello. I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in to see me today?

Hello, Dr. Smith. Thank you kindly for seeing me, sir. I hope I'm not taking up too much of your busy day. 

Well, I came in because... I don't want to sound foolish, and I hope you don't think I'm making a mountain out of a molehill, but I've been noticing some things lately. The men down at the domino table, and sometimes even the announcer on the radio, they've been giving these little messages. Just meant for me, you know? My wife, she says it's just regular talk and I'm getting worked up over nothing. But... I know they are warning me to be careful. 

Am I explaining that right, Doc? I just wanted to see if that's something I should be worried about, or if I'm doing the right thing by being here.
Aside from these messages, have you been hearing any voices or sounds that other people do not seem to notice?

Well, sir... I, uh... I hate to even bring it up, because I sure don't want you thinking my mind is going bad on me. It's really nothing bothersome at all. But, well... some afternoons, when the house gets real quiet, I... I hear my old friend. 

I'll hear him call my name from out on the porch, or sometimes he just hums a little choir song. It's clear as day, just like he is standing right there. It's a real peaceful sound, honestly, so I try not to make a fuss over it. 

Is that the sort of thing you were asking about, Dr. Smith? I hope I'm giving you the right answers.
Have you been feeling exceptionally low, hopeless, or perhaps unusually energetic and impulsive during the time you have been noticing these messages and hearing your friend?

Well, sir... I suppose there have been times when I get a bit, well, extra spry, you might say. I hope that's alright to admit. Sometimes I get these spells where I just feel so bright and restless, and I hardly need a wink of sleep. I start making all sorts of big plans for fixing up the house or organizing the garage. It's really just me trying to be productive, you know? I don't want you to think I'm acting foolish or out of control. 

But, well, to answer your question... yes, sir. Even during those energetic weeks, I still hear my old friend humming or calling for me. And I still get those little warnings from the radio or the fellas at the domino table. It doesn't seem to stop just because I've got a lot of pep in my step. 

Does that make sense, Doc? I hope I'm explaining it clearly enough for you. I just want to make sure I'm giving you what you need.
Have there been any periods of time where you experienced these messages and heard your friend when you were NOT feeling especially energetic or restless?

Well, yes, sir, there have been times like that. I hope it's okay to say so. I don't want to make it sound like things are always out of sorts with me. 

But, let's see... just a little while back, I had a real quiet month. I was sleeping just fine, regular hours, you know, and I wasn't getting all worked up with those big plans or feeling restless at all. I was just taking it easy, like a fellow my age ought to. But even then, I'd still hear my friend out on the porch, just as clear. And I still felt sure the radio was sending me those little messages. 

It didn't seem to matter that I was feeling perfectly calm and normal otherwise. Is that... is that helpful to know, Dr. Smith? I hope I'm giving you the right kind of details. I just want to make sure I'm doing a good job answering your questions.
Have there been any periods of at least two weeks where you felt deeply sad, hopeless, or lost interest in all your usual hobbies and activities?

Well, sir... no, I can't say that I have. I hope that's the right answer, but I really don't get down in the dumps like that. 

I mean, I might have a quiet day here or there, just resting my bones, but I don't ever feel hopeless or lose my interest in things. I still like my dominoes and sitting out on the porch. I try to keep a positive outlook, you know? I wouldn't want to be a burden or be moping around all day. 

So, no, sir, no long spells of feeling sad like that. I hope that's okay to say. I just want to be honest with you, Doc. Am I doing alright with these questions?
Have you noticed any times where your thoughts seem to get jumbled up, or people have had a hard time following what you are saying?

Well, sir... I suppose sometimes things do get a little, well, tangled up up there. I hope it doesn't make me sound foolish to admit that. 

It's just that, especially when I get those restless spells, my mind just starts running. It'll go from thinking about the church choir, right over to the baseball game, then to fixing the back step, and then back to my old friend... all so fast. It's like I can't hold onto just one thought long enough to explain it right to anyone. 

My daughter, she'll look at me a bit confused sometimes and ask me to slow down. I don't mean to talk nonsense, I really don't. I just have so many ideas going at once, you see? I try my best to speak clear. Does that make sense, Doctor? I hope I'm not sounding too scattered for you.

Looking back over the last several months, have there been any periods of at least two weeks where you were experiencing those messages and hearing your friend, while you were NOT feeling that restless 'spry' energy at all?

Well, yes, sir, I believe we did just touch on that a moment ago... I hope you don't mind me repeating myself, I just want to make sure I'm answering exactly what you need. 

Like I was saying, there was that one quiet month recently. I wasn't feeling spry or restless at all. I was sleeping just fine, regular hours, and I wasn't getting all worked up with any big plans. But even during that calm time, I still heard my friend out there on the porch, plain as day. And I still felt certain the radio was sending me those messages. 

It was just a peaceful time otherwise, but those things were still happening. Is that... does that help clear it up, Dr. Smith? I hope I'm doing a good job explaining it all for you.
